resources.string: Palette roles, icon foreground and background
Compare light and dark icons before applying
Inspect the draft and the reported system palette
Changes stay in your draft until you apply them.
Choose a category to edit your draft. Returning to the overview keeps your changes. Preview both appearances, then tap Apply. Refresh reads the current system state without applying your draft.

Apply colors saves the palette without changing the Monet switch. If Monet is off, icons keep their current appearance; enabling Monet uses the saved palette. The floating Apply colors button is shared by the whole page.
Icon appearance and coloring unthemed icons require regenerating the icon pack. Install inspiration icons directly on the Monet page; applying colors and enabling Monet are separate operations.
